query: WITH seen AS (UPDATE device_node_keys k SET last_seen_at = now() FROM unnest($2::text[], $3::text[]) AS reported(node_id, address) WHERE k.tenant_id = $1 AND k.node_id = reported.node_id AND k.revoked_at IS NULL RETURNING k.paired_device_id, reported.address) UPDATE paired_devices d SET last_seen_at = now(), last_seen_ip = seen.address::inet FROM seen WHERE d.id = seen.paired_device_id
